neighbours.label: 'not' (or the carve-out) in a restrictive clause that singles out the remaining part ('the 50% that is not genetic')
fire: For the share of the income that is not taxed, rules differ.
The portion of the land that is not farmed is left wild.
Any part of the meal that is not eaten goes to the pigs.
The fraction of light that is not absorbed is reflected.
That half of the risk that is not inherited depends on habits.
For the 30% of cases that are not explained, doctors guess.
Whatever part of the grant is not spent must be returned.
The share of the vote that is not counted yet is small.
quiet: For the share of the income that is taxed, rules differ.
The portion of the land that is farmed is very fertile.
Any part of the meal that is eaten is recorded.
The fraction of light that is absorbed warms the water.
That half of the risk that is inherited is hard to change.
For the 30% of cases that are explained, doctors agree.
Whatever part of the grant is spent must be reported.
The share of the vote that is counted already is large.

notes: card: no single token (' are', ' what', ' that', ' not'); logit effect promotes directly/manually/explicit. Probes: 'the part of the budget that is not fixed' 0.47, 'the 50% that is not genetic' 0.57, 'rooms that are not booked' 0.16.
